test_cases.name: Valid Login
steps: tap the element with testID login-username-input and type 'jane'
tap the element with testID login-password-input and type 'pass'
tap the element with testID login-submit-button
test_cases.expected: the Sign in button is enabled

test_cases.name: Invalid Username
steps: tap the element with testID login-username-input and type 'locked'
test_cases.expected: an error message is shown on screen

test_cases.name: Empty Fields
steps: tap the element with testID login-username-input
tap the element with testID login-password-input
test_cases.expected: the Sign in button remains disabled
